recipe.text: Fresh concept: a Stone Golem brute, distinct from prior husk/melee variants. Built from a native R15 block rig, recolored Slate gray with a bulked torso, oversized blocky fists, stubby legs, and an emissive orange chest core + eyes for readability. make_npc wired server AI (idle->chase->attack->dead) with high damage (40), low speed (6), short detect range (20), attackRange 7, cooldown 2.0s. HRP is collidable so it doesn't sink. NpcState attribute tracks state for VERIFY.
